name: Book Shelf
description: Interactive bookshelf where hovering a book slides it out of the shelf with a shadow shift while its title, author and description animate in below.
contents: Row of book covers with a narrow side-spine book on a shelf board
Description block per book with title, author and text
behavior: Hovering a book pulls its cover forward, shifts pages and grows its floor shadow with GSAP timelines
Description lines slide up in a stagger for the hovered book and slide out for the previous one
Leaving the shelf returns to the default open book
editableByProps: Books, covers, descriptions, side book and default open book
All colors, shelf width, book size, font family and dot grid

needsCodeEdit.change: Change hover pull-out distance or timing of a book
needsCodeEdit.where: bookTimelinesRef setup inside the first useEffect

needsCodeEdit.change: Change shelf position or description area size
needsCodeEdit.where: bottom-[270px] shelf board and bottom-[30px] description container

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Bricolage Grotesque font from Google Fonts through link tags
Needs at least two books for the side book to appear between them
Shelf layout is positioned inside a fixed 500px tall stage
